description: Single unsuffixed table of localized system UI strings. Unlike the other text groups, every row carries one FString column per application language; SYS_-prefixed ids are routed here by AGameTextManager.

ID.simple: System text id (row key), always starting with SYS_.
ID.technical: FName ID of FGameDataTableRow_SystemText, stored beside the UDataTable row name and used by FindRow in the single unsuffixed SystemTextDataTable. AGameTextManager::GetText dispatches ids whose string starts with 'SYS_' (case-insensitive) to the system table instead of the 14 localized GameText tables. HasText uses the same split, and FGameTextRequestParameter (GameTextParameterMap_AddTextId) can nest a SYS_ id inside another localized string, in which case the nested lookup uses the request language.

Ja.technical: FString column of FGameDataTableRow_SystemText; GetLanguageText reads row +0x10 + 0x10 * EApplicationLanguage index and returns a copy. AGameTextManager::GetSystemText selects this column when FGameTextRequest.Language == Ja (the usual constructors take GameManager's current language; explicit-language overloads exist), then runs FormatText. Missing row or unmatched language returns an empty FString. The companion export has 1286 of 1287 rows populated in this column.

En.technical: FString column selected by EApplicationLanguage::En through GetLanguageText (row +0x10 + 0x10 * language index), copied out by GetSystemText and formatted with GLO/DYN/modifier rules. 1286 populated rows in the companion export; blank cells render as empty strings.

Fr.technical: FString column selected by EApplicationLanguage::Fr through GetLanguageText (row +0x10 + 0x10 * language index), copied out by GetSystemText and formatted with GLO/DYN/modifier rules. 1285 populated rows in the companion export.

Es.technical: FString column selected by EApplicationLanguage::Es through GetLanguageText (row +0x10 + 0x10 * language index), copied out by GetSystemText and formatted with GLO/DYN/modifier rules. Distinct from Es_LA. 1285 populated rows in the companion export.

Text blocks with bForceOneLine remove newlines for this language.

Text blocks with bForceOneLine remove newlines for this language; FormatText also injects GLS_GAME_WORDS_3000/3004 for DYN=FRIEND_WORD/FREND_LIST_WORD tags.

Ar.technical: FString column with an EApplicationLanguage::Ar case in GetLanguageText; a GetSystemText request with Language == Ar would read and format it. No localized GameText table variants or chunk rules for Ar appear in the loader/Config, and only 12 rows are populated in the companion export, so most requests resolve to empty text. This column is not read by the 11 language-suffixed GameText tables.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_SystemText has 17 reflected fields (ID plus 16 language strings); the retail GetLanguageText switch (0x14af7b0 jump table 0x14afb64) maps EApplicationLanguage values Ja..Th to consecutive 0x10-byte slots. The companion export has 1287 rows with identical ids; Ar/Ind/Pl/Ru/Th have only 12 populated rows each, Ko has all 1287, and a few rows are blank in individual other columns. EApplicationLanguage::Invalid and out-of-range values return an empty FString.

Loading differs from every other text group: StartInitialLoading creates a loader for the bare name 'SystemTextDataTable' (GameTextManager.cpp:24) and Tick assigns it to SystemTextDataTables (line 543) once, not per language. No SystemTextDataTable_<Language> assets are requested in StartLanguageLoading, and Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 only covers the language-suffixed GameText tables.

Routing: IsSystemTextId checks the 'SYS_' prefix case-insensitively (line 607), so all other ids go to the 14-table GameText pool. GetSystemText picks Request.Language (line 718); the id-only FGameTextRequest constructors capture GameManager+0x370 (current language), while explicit-language overloads exist (GameTextRequest.h:97-100). The result is formatted with the same GLO/DYN/modifier pipeline as GameText rows (line 720).

Substantive consumers include system dialog messages (SYS_DIALOG_MESSAGE_0001/0301), common labels for buttons/input guides (SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0002/0113/0121/1003+), configuration/license labels, free-battle time labels and Visual Lobby match-rule labels via GetSystemTextById. GameTextParameterPrivate::GroupDigits formats thousands separators through SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0122..0124, and decimal points through SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0121 (GameTextManager.cpp:207-222, 270, 362).

Reconstruction caveat: GetSystemText is byte-matched to retail (status/functions.json 0x14af7b0), while the row finder and Tick are behaviour-certified (0x14af3d0, 0x14c96f0; BEHAV BG03). GetLanguageText and field names are reconstructed; only partial Content is available, so retail Blueprint-only uses cannot be enumerated.

usages.detail: Creates the primary asset loader for the single unsuffixed SystemTextDataTable at initial load.
Stores the resolved table in SystemTextDataTables, separate from the localized GameText table array.
IsSystemTextId routes SYS_ ids to the system table; all other ids use GameText rows.
Finds the row and selects the column matching the request language before formatting.
Requests SYS_DIALOG_MESSAGE_0301 with MISSION_NAME and other parameters through GetText.
Uses GetSystemTextById for free-battle time labels, with an int parameter for the minutes option.
Uses GetSystemTextById(SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0104) with parameters for Visual Lobby rule descriptions.
GroupDigits resolves SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0122..0124 to format thousands-separated numbers.
